description: No latency histogram -> latency SLI goes to Gaps
input:
Service: auth-api, used by every other service for token checks. Metrics:
grpc_server_handled_total{grpc_service="auth",grpc_code="..."}
golden_output:
### Service
auth-api validates tokens for every other internal service, so its failures cascade.

### SLIs
- Availability — `sum(rate(grpc_server_handled_total{grpc_service="auth",grpc_code!~"Unavailable|Internal|Unknown|DeadlineExceeded"}[5m])) / sum(rate(grpc_server_handled_total{grpc_service="auth"}[5m]))` — a failed token check fails the caller's request.

### Objectives
- Availability 99.95% over 28 days — error budget (1 − 0.9995) × 40,320 min = 20.2 minutes.

### Burn-rate alerts
- Recording rules: `availability_sli_<window>` is the availability SLI with `[5m]` replaced by `[<window>]`, for 5m, 30m, 1h and 6h.
- Page: burn rate above 14.4x over 1h and 5m — `(1 - availability_sli_1h) > (14.4 * 0.0005) and (1 - availability_sli_5m) > (14.4 * 0.0005)`.
- Ticket: burn rate above 6x over 6h and 30m — `(1 - availability_sli_6h) > (6 * 0.0005) and (1 - availability_sli_30m) > (6 * 0.0005)`.

### Gaps
- No latency histogram, so a latency SLI is not possible; add `grpc_server_handling_seconds_bucket` (go-grpc-prometheus with histograms enabled).
